title: Deprecated GitHub Actions ::set-output command
summary: GitHub deprecated the ::set-output workflow command. Append to the GITHUB_OUTPUT environment file instead.

sources.title: GitHub Actions: Deprecating save-state and set-output commands

constraints: Use environment files with a runner version supporting them. Multiline values require delimiter syntax.
Preserve the effective shell and quote expansion; never copy encoded command values directly.

steps.title: Append to GITHUB_OUTPUT
steps.instructions: Replace literal single-line echo commands with the corresponding environment-file append to "$GITHUB_OUTPUT". Migrate complex values manually.

verification.purpose: Review the workflow patch before running it.
